pages.title: Choosing a Bulk T-Shirt Printer in the UAE: 7 Checks
pages.description: How to vet a bulk t-shirt printer in the UAE: print methods and real costs, fabric weight truths, MOQ traps and the red flags that cost deadlines.
pages.h1: Choosing a Bulk T-Shirt Printer in the UAE
pages.heroAlt: Bulk t-shirt printing in the UAE — printed t-shirts ready for packing
pages.lede: Methods, fabric truths, portfolio checks and red flags — how procurement teams vet a garment partner.
pages.intro: Most bulk printing orders in the UAE go wrong for the same four reasons: the wrong print method for the quantity, a fabric weight that was quoted but not delivered, a supplier who outsources the print without telling you, and no physical sample before bulk. Here is how to check each one.

sections.h2: 1. Match the print method to the quantity
sections.p: Under 100 pieces, DTF is cheaper because there is no screen setup. Above 100 pieces with 1–4 colours, screen printing wins on unit cost and wash durability. Sublimation is only for polyester. Anyone who quotes the same method for a 30-piece and a 3,000-piece run is not thinking about your cost.

sections.h2: 2. Ask for the GSM, then weigh the sample
sections.p: A quoted 180 GSM tee and a delivered 160 GSM tee feel completely different. Weigh the sample on a scale — a size L 180 GSM tee should land close to the expected gram weight. Ask for the fabric certificate, not a verbal number.

Outsourced print adds a third-party lead time you cannot control. Ask which steps happen in the supplier's own facility: cutting, stitching, printing, pressing, packing. Same-day turnaround is only real if the press is on their floor.
A digital mockup proves nothing about ink adhesion, colour accuracy or hand feel. Sampling should take 5–7 days and should be a real garment, printed on the real fabric, at the real size.

sections.h2: 5. Check the portfolio for repeat clients
sections.p: One-off event work is easy. Look for brands that have re-ordered across multiple seasons — that is the only real evidence of consistency.
A low headline price with a 500-piece MOQ is not a low price if you need 80 pieces. Ask for a tiered quote at 50, 100, 250 and 500 so you can see the real curve.

No physical address or factory visit offered, no wash-test claim, no per-piece breakdown, prices quoted before knowing the artwork, and urgency used as a sales tactic instead of a production capability.

faq.q: What is a fair MOQ for custom t-shirts in the UAE?
faq.a: 10–12 pieces per style on printed blanks is a reasonable minimum for a genuine manufacturer. Much higher usually means the supplier only wants bulk runs.

faq.q: How long should sampling take?
faq.a: 5–7 days is standard for a UAE factory with in-house printing. Longer usually means the print is being outsourced.
